expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Appends one element. @param Value Element copied or referenced according to T. Appends all elements from another array. Randomly permutes the elements. Inserts an element and shifts following elements. @param Value Element to insert. @param Index Zero-based insertion position. Adds the value only when no equal element exists; returns whether insertion occurred. Removes all elements and sets the requested slack. @param ReservedSize Capacity to retain after clearing. Removes all elements while reusing allocation when possible. @param ReservedSize Minimum capacity to retain. Ensures capacity for at least the requested number of elements. Resizes the array, constructing or removing elements as needed. Resizes the array and zero-initializes newly added storage.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Cover null/non-null and object identity where the environment can produce both. Exercise both true and false outcomes unless the API contract documents a single reachable result.
inputs: Seeded receiver state, the exact mutation arguments, repeated-call behavior, and cleanup or restoration inputs where the operation owns resources.
